name: panic-capture
description: Port of `make debug-test x86_64 debug testrunner tools/gdb/test-batch.gdb`: QEMU owned by make debug-test; the GDB script breaks on panic, captures state, touches build/gdb-panic-captured and exits 1. make debug-test intentionally exits 1 on capture, so accept_exit [0,1] and the 'GDB PANIC CAPTURED' marker is the success oracle.
